name: Acid Arrow
description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the start of its next turn.
notes: Ranged spell attack: 4d4 acid on a hit, then 2d4 more at the start of the target's next turn.
